questions.text: sin⁻¹ (2x² – 3) का प्रांत है :
questions.text_english: Domain of sin⁻¹ (2x² – 3) is :
questions.solution: For sin⁻¹(2x² – 3) to be defined, we need –1 ≤ 2x² – 3 ≤ 1. From 2x² – 3 ≥ –1, we get x² ≥ 1, so x ≤ –1 or x ≥ 1. From 2x² – 3 ≤ 1, we get x² ≤ 2, so –√2 ≤ x ≤ √2. Combining both conditions, the domain is [–√2, –1] ∪ [1, √2], which is option (C). Options (A), (B), and (D) use open intervals at the boundary points, which are incorrect since equality holds at those endpoints.

A matrix A is skew symmetric if Aᵀ = –A. For the given matrix, the transpose has entries aᵢⱼ replaced by aⱼᵢ. Checking: the (1,2) entry is 1 and (2,1) entry is −1 (negatives of each other); (1,3) entry is −2 and (3,1) is 2; (2,3) entry is −7 and (3,2) is 7. All diagonal entries are 0. Since every entry satisfies aᵢⱼ = –aⱼᵢ and diagonal entries are 0, the matrix is skew symmetric. It is not diagonal (has non-zero off-diagonal entries), not symmetric (as aᵢⱼ ≠ aⱼᵢ), and not scalar.

questions.text_english: If f(x) = {3x – 2, 0 < x ≤ 1; 2x² + ax, 1 < x < 2} is continuous for x ∈ (0, 2), then a is equal to :
questions.solution: For continuity at x = 1, the left-hand limit must equal the right-hand limit. LHL = 3(1) – 2 = 1. RHL = 2(1)² + a(1) = 2 + a. Setting LHL = RHL: 1 = 2 + a, so a = –1. Therefore option (D) is correct. Options (A), (B), and (C) give values –4, −7/2, and −2 respectively, which do not satisfy the continuity condition at x = 1.

questions.text: यदि y = log₂ₓ (√2x) है, तो dy/dx बराबर है :
questions.text_english: If y = log₂ₓ (√2x), then dy/dx is equal to :
questions.solution: We have y = log₂ₓ(√2x). Using the change of base formula, log₂ₓ(√2x) = ln(√2x) / ln(2x). Now ln(√2x) = (1/2)ln(2x), so y = (1/2)ln(2x) / ln(2x) = 1/2. But this is a constant, so dy/dx = 0. Wait, re-reading: y = log_(2x)(√(2x)) = ln(√(2x))/ln(2x) = (1/2)ln(2x)/ln(2x) = 1/2, a constant, giving dy/dx = 0. Actually the correct reading is log base 2x of √(2x) which simplifies to 1/2, giving derivative 0. However option (B) = 1 corresponds to y = log_(2x)(2x) = 1. Re-examining: the problem states y = log_{2x}(√{2x}). Since √(2x) = (2x)^{1/2}, we get y = (1/2)log_{2x}(2x) = 1/2, which is constant. So dy/dx = 0, i.e., option (A). The correct answer is (A) = 0.

questions.text: यदि f : N → W, f(n) = {n/2, यदि n सम है; 0, यदि n विषम है} द्वारा परिभाषित है, तो f :
questions.text_english: If f : N → W is defined as f(n) = {n/2, if n is even; 0, if n is odd}, then f is :

options.D: न तो आच्छादी है और न ही एकैकी

questions.solution: The function maps all odd natural numbers to 0, so f(1) = 0 and f(3) = 0, meaning f is not injective (one-one) since two distinct elements map to the same value. For surjectivity, every whole number w ∈ W can be written as f(2w) = w, so every element of the codomain W is achieved. Hence f is surjective (onto) but not injective, making option (B) correct.

questions.text: बिंदु A(– 2, 3, 5) से y-अक्ष पर खींचे गए लंब के पाद के निर्देशांक हैं :
questions.text_english: The coordinates of the foot of the perpendicular drawn from the point A(– 2, 3, 5) on the y-axis is :
questions.solution: The y-axis consists of all points of the form (0, y, 0). The foot of the perpendicular from point A(–2, 3, 5) to the y-axis is obtained by setting x = 0 and z = 0, and retaining the y-coordinate of A, giving the foot as (0, 3, 0). Option (B) is correct. Option (A) retains z and drops x and y incorrectly, option (C) retains x and z, and option (D) retains x only.

questions.text: यदि A तथा B दो ऐसे कोटि 3 × 3 के व्युत्क्रमणीय आव्यूह हैं कि det(A) = 4 तथा det[(AB)⁻¹] = 1/20 है, तो det(B) बराबर है :
questions.text_english: If A and B are invertible matrices of order 3 × 3 such that det(A) = 4 and det[(AB)⁻¹] = 1/20, then det(B) is equal to :
questions.solution: We know det[(AB)⁻¹] = 1/det(AB) = 1/[det(A)·det(B)]. Given this equals 1/20, we have det(A)·det(B) = 20. Since det(A) = 4, we get 4·det(B) = 20, so det(B) = 5. Therefore option (D) is correct.

questions.text: माना वास्तविक x के लिए, f(x) = x³ + 5x + 1 है, तो :
questions.text_english: For real x, let f(x) = x³ + 5x + 1. Then :

options.A: f, R पर एकैकी है लेकिन आच्छादक नहीं है
options.B: f, R पर आच्छादक है लेकिन एकैकी नहीं है
options.C: f, R पर एकैकी और आच्छादक है
options.D: f, R पर न तो एकैकी है और न ही आच्छादक

options_english.A: f is one-one but not onto on R
options_english.B: f is onto on R but not one-one
options_english.C: f is one-one and onto on R
options_english.D: f is neither one-one nor onto on R

questions.solution: We have f'(x) = 3x² + 5 > 0 for all real x, since 3x² ≥ 0 and 5 > 0. Since f'(x) > 0 everywhere, f is strictly increasing and hence one-one (injective). As x → +∞, f(x) → +∞, and as x → –∞, f(x) → –∞, so the range of f is all of R, making f onto (surjective). Thus f is a bijection, and option (C) is correct.

questions.text: λ के वे मान जिनके लिए f(x) = sin x – cos x – λx + C, x के सभी वास्तविक मानों के लिए ह्रासमान है, हैं :
questions.text_english: The values of λ so that f(x) = sin x – cos x – λx + C decreases for all real values of x are :
questions.solution: For f(x) to be decreasing for all real x, we need f'(x) ≤ 0 for all x. f'(x) = cos x + sin x – λ. The maximum value of cos x + sin x is √2. So for f'(x) ≤ 0 for all x, we need λ ≥ √2. Thus the correct answer is option (C).

questions.text: यदि A तथा B समान कोटि के वर्ग आव्यूह हैं तथा AB = A तथा BA = B है, तो A² + B² बराबर है :
questions.text_english: If A and B are square matrices of same order such that AB = A and BA = B, then A² + B² is equal to :
questions.solution: Given AB = A and BA = B. Then A² = A·A = A·(BA) = (AB)A = A·A. Using AB = A: A² = A(BA) = (AB)A = AA. Also A² = A·A; since AB = A, multiply both sides by A on right: ABA = A², but BA = B so A·B = A². Wait, let us redo: A² = A·A = (AB)·A [since AB = A] = A(BA) = A·B = AB = A. Similarly B² = B·B = (BA)·B [since BA = B] = B(AB) = B·A = BA = B. So A² + B² = A + B, which is option (A).

questions.text: वक्र y = √x, रेखाओं x = 0 तथा x = 4 तथा x-अक्ष से घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल है :
questions.text_english: The area of the region enclosed by the curve y = √x and the lines x = 0 and x = 4 and x-axis is :
questions.solution: The area = ∫₀⁴ √x dx = ∫₀⁴ x^(1/2) dx = [x^(3/2) / (3/2)]₀⁴ = (2/3)[x^(3/2)]₀⁴ = (2/3)(4^(3/2) – 0) = (2/3)(8) = 16/3 sq. units. Therefore option (C) is correct.

questions.text: ∫₀¹ dx/(eˣ + e⁻ˣ) का मान है :
questions.text_english: The value of ∫₀¹ dx/(eˣ + e⁻ˣ) is :
questions.solution: ∫ dx/(eˣ + e⁻ˣ) = ∫ eˣ/(e²ˣ + 1) dx. Let u = eˣ, du = eˣ dx, so the integral becomes ∫ du/(u² + 1) = tan⁻¹(u) + C = tan⁻¹(eˣ) + C. Evaluating from 0 to 1: tan⁻¹(e¹) – tan⁻¹(e⁰) = tan⁻¹(e) – tan⁻¹(1) = tan⁻¹(e) – π/4. So the answer is option (C).

questions.text: एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या (LPP) के सुसंगत क्षेत्र के कोणीय बिंदु (0, 2), (3, 0), (6, 0), (6, 8) तथा (0, 5) हैं। यदि उद्देश्य फलन Z = ax + by; (a, b > 0) का अधिकतम मान (0, 2) तथा (3, 0) पर प्राप्त होता है, तो a तथा b में संबंध है :
questions.text_english: The corner points of the feasible region of a Linear Programming Problem are (0, 2), (3, 0), (6, 0), (6, 8) and (0, 5). If Z = ax + by; (a, b > 0) be the objective function, and maximum value of Z is obtained at (0, 2) and (3, 0), then the relation between a and b is :
questions.solution: Since Z has the same maximum value at (0, 2) and (3, 0), we have Z(0, 2) = Z(3, 0). This gives a(0) + b(2) = a(3) + b(0), so 2b = 3a, which means 3a = 2b. Therefore option (D) is correct.

questions.text: यदि ∫ e⁻³ ˡᵒᵍ ˣ dx = f(x) + C है, तो f(x) है :
questions.text_english: If ∫ e⁻³ ˡᵒᵍ ˣ dx = f(x) + C, then f(x) is :
questions.solution: We have e⁻³ ˡᵒᵍ ˣ = e^(log x⁻³) = x⁻³ = 1/x³. So ∫ e⁻³ log x dx = ∫ x⁻³ dx = x⁻²/(−2) + C = −1/(2x²) + C. Therefore f(x) = −1/(2x²), which is option (C).

questions.text: फलन f(x) = {x, यदि x ≤ 1; 5, यदि x > 1} द्वारा परिभाषित फलन f संतत नहीं है :
questions.text_english: The function f defined by f(x) = {x, if x ≤ 1; 5, if x > 1} is not continuous at :
questions.solution: At x = 1: LHL = lim(x→1⁻) f(x) = 1, f(1) = 1, but RHL = lim(x→1⁺) f(x) = 5. Since RHL ≠ LHL, f is not continuous at x = 1. At x = 0, 2, and 5, the function uses a single piece and is continuous there. Therefore option (B) is correct.

questions.text: अवकल समीकरण dy/dx = –x/y का हल जिस कुल को निरूपित करता है, वह है :
questions.text_english: The solution of the differential equation dy/dx = –x/y represents family of :
questions.solution: Separating variables: y dy = –x dx. Integrating both sides: y²/2 = –x²/2 + C, which gives x² + y² = 2C = constant. This is the equation of a family of circles centred at the origin. Therefore option (B) is correct.

questions.text: यदि Δ ABC की भुजाएँ AB तथा AC क्रमश: सदिशों ĵ + k̂ तथा 3î – ĵ + 4k̂ द्वारा निरूपित हैं, तो A से BC पर खींची गई माध्यिका की लंबाई है :
questions.text_english: If the sides AB and AC of Δ ABC are represented by vectors ĵ + k̂ and 3î – ĵ + 4k̂ respectively, then the length of the median through A on BC is :
questions.solution: Let AB = ĵ + k̂ and AC = 3î – ĵ + 4k̂. The median from A bisects BC, so the median vector AM = (AB + AC)/2 = (ĵ + k̂ + 3î – ĵ + 4k̂)/2 = (3î + 0ĵ + 5k̂)/2. Its magnitude = (1/2)√(9 + 0 + 25) = (1/2)√34 = √34/2. Therefore option (C) is correct.

questions.text: यदि f(x) = 2x + cos x है, तो f(x) :
questions.text_english: If f(x) = 2x + cos x, then f(x) :

options.A: का x = π पर अधिकतम मान है
options.B: का x = π पर न्यूनतम मान है

options_english.A: has a maxima at x = π
options_english.B: has a minima at x = π

questions.solution: f'(x) = 2 – sin x. Since −1 ≤ sin x ≤ 1, we have 2 – sin x ≥ 2 – 1 = 1 > 0 for all x. Since f'(x) > 0 everywhere, f is strictly increasing. Therefore option (C) is correct. f has no local maxima or minima, and it is certainly not decreasing.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): यदि A तथा B दो ऐसी घटनाएँ हैं कि P(A ∩ B) = 0 है, तो A तथा B स्वतंत्र घटनाएँ हैं।
तर्क (R): दो घटनाएँ स्वतंत्र होती हैं यदि एक के घटने का दूसरे के घटने पर कोई प्रभाव न पड़े।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): If A and B are two events such that P(A ∩ B) = 0, then A and B are independent events.
Reason (R): Two events are independent if the occurrence of one does not effect the occurrence of the other.
questions.instruction_line: प्रश्न संख्या 19 और 20 अभिकथन एवं तर्क आधारित प्रश्न हैं।
questions.instruction_line_english: Questions number 19 and 20 are Assertion and Reason based questions. Select the correct answer from codes (A), (B), (C) and (D).

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is false: P(A ∩ B) = 0 means A and B are mutually exclusive, not independent. For independence, we need P(A ∩ B) = P(A)·P(B). If P(A) > 0 and P(B) > 0, then P(A)·P(B) > 0 ≠ 0, so mutually exclusive events cannot be independent (unless one has zero probability). Reason (R) is true as it correctly defines independence. Therefore option (D) is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या (LPP) में यदि सुसंगत क्षेत्र खाली है, तो रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या (LPP) का कोई हल नहीं है।
तर्क (R): सुसंगत क्षेत्र वह क्षेत्र है जिसमें सारे व्यवरोध संतुष्ट होते हैं।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): In a Linear Programming Problem, if the feasible region is empty, then the Linear Programming Problem has no solution.
Reason (R): A feasible region is defined as the region that satisfies all the constraints.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are true. If the feasible region is empty, there are no points satisfying all constraints, so no feasible solution exists and the LPP has no solution – Assertion (A) is true. The Reason (R) correctly defines the feasible region as the set of all points satisfying all constraints, which directly explains why an empty feasible region leads to no solution. So option (A) is correct.

questions.text: यदि A = [[2, −2], [−2, 2]] है तथा A² = kA है, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: If A = [[2, −2], [−2, 2]] and A² = kA, then find the value of k.

questions.text:
(क) sin⁻¹(x / √(1 + x²)) को सरलतम रूप में लिखिए।
अथवा
(ख) sin⁻¹√(x – 1) का प्रांत ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Simplify sin⁻¹(x / √(1 + x²)).
OR
(b) Find domain of sin⁻¹√(x – 1).
questions.solution:
(a) Let x = tan θ, so θ = tan⁻¹ x. Then x/√(1 + x²) = tanθ/√(1 + tan²θ) = tanθ/secθ = sinθ. Therefore sin⁻¹(x/√(1 + x²)) = sin⁻¹(sinθ) = θ = tan⁻¹ x.

(b) For sin⁻¹√(x – 1) to be defined, we need 0 ≤ √(x – 1) ≤ 1 (since sin⁻¹ is defined for arguments in [−1, 1] and √(x–1) ≥ 0). From √(x – 1) ≤ 1: x – 1 ≤ 1, so x ≤ 2. From √(x – 1) ≥ 0: x – 1 ≥ 0, so x ≥ 1. Therefore the domain is [1, 2].
questions.topic: Simplification and Domain of Inverse Trig Functions

questions.text: समाकलन के प्रयोग से, वक्र x²/9 + y²/4 = 1 तथा x-अक्ष के बीच घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल परिकलित कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Calculate the area of the region bounded by the curve x²/9 + y²/4 = 1 and the x-axis using integration.
questions.solution: The ellipse x²/9 + y²/4 = 1 has semi-axes a = 3 (along x) and b = 2 (along y). The area bounded by the ellipse and the x-axis (upper half) is ∫₋³³ y dx = ∫₋³³ (2/3)√(9 – x²) dx. Using the standard result ∫₋ᵃᵃ √(a² – x²) dx = πa²/2, we get area = (2/3) · (9π/2) = 3π sq. units. (For the region between the ellipse and the x-axis, this gives 3π.)

questions.text:
(क) 'a' का वह न्यूनतम मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके लिए f(x) = 2x² – ax + 3; [2, 4] पर एक वर्धमान फलन हो।
अथवा
(ख) यदि f(x) = x + 1/x, x ≥ 1 है, तो दर्शाइए कि f एक वर्धमान फलन है।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find the least value of 'a' so that f(x) = 2x² – ax + 3 is an increasing function on [2, 4].
OR
(b) If f(x) = x + 1/x, x ≥ 1, show that f is an increasing function.
questions.solution:
(a) f'(x) = 4x – a. For f to be increasing on [2, 4], we need f'(x) ≥ 0 for all x ∈ [2, 4]. The minimum of f'(x) on [2, 4] occurs at x = 2, giving f'(2) = 8 – a ≥ 0, so a ≤ 8. The least value of a satisfying this is a = 8.

(b) f'(x) = 1 – 1/x² = (x² – 1)/x². For x ≥ 1, x² ≥ 1, so x² – 1 ≥ 0 and x² > 0. Hence f'(x) ≥ 0 for all x ≥ 1, which means f is an increasing function on [1, ∞).

questions.text: एक बेलनाकार पानी से भरा बर्तन तल से लीक कर रहा है। तल से पानी 5 cm³/s की दर से लीक कर रहा है। यदि बर्तन की त्रिज्या 15 cm है, तो बर्तन में पानी के तल की ऊँचाई के घटने की दर ज्ञात कीजिए जबकि पानी की ऊँचाई 2 मीटर है।
questions.text_english: A cylindrical water container has developed a leak at the bottom. The water is leaking at the rate of 5 cm³/s from the leak. If the radius of the container is 15 cm, find the rate at which the height of water is decreasing inside the container, when the height of water is 2 metres.
questions.solution: Volume of cylinder V = πr²h, where r = 15 cm (constant). So dV/dt = πr² (dh/dt) = π(225)(dh/dt). Given dV/dt = −5 cm³/s (decreasing). Therefore −5 = 225π (dh/dt), giving dh/dt = −5/(225π) = −1/(45π) cm/s. The height is decreasing at the rate of 1/(45π) cm/s.

questions.text_english: Find the distance of the point (−1, −5, −10) from the point of intersection of the lines (x−1)/2 = (y−2)/3 = (z−3)/4 and (x−4)/5 = (y−1)/2 = z.
questions.topic: Point of Intersection of Lines in 3D

questions.text:
(क) यदि f : R⁺ → R, f(x) = logₐ x (a > 0 तथा a ≠ 1) द्वारा परिभाषित है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि f एक एकैकी-आच्छादक फलन है।
(R⁺ सभी धनात्मक वास्तविक संख्याओं का समुच्चय है।)
अथवा
(ख) माना A = {1, 2, 3} तथा B = {4, 5, 6}. A से B में एक संबंध R इस प्रकार परिभाषित है कि R = {(x, y) : x + y = 6, x ∈ A, y ∈ B} है।
(i) R के सभी अवयव लिखिए।
(ii) क्या R एक फलन है ? सत्यापित कीजिए।
(iii) R का प्रांत व परिसर ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) If f : R⁺ → R is defined as f(x) = logₐ x (a > 0 and a ≠ 1), prove that f is a bijection.
(R⁺ is a set of all positive real numbers.)
OR
(b) Let A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {4, 5, 6}. A relation R from A to B is defined as R = {(x, y) : x + y = 6, x ∈ A, y ∈ B}.
(i) Write all elements of R.
(ii) Is R a function? Justify.
(iii) Determine domain and range of R.

key_points: (a) One-one: logₐx₁ = logₐx₂ ⇒ x₁ = x₂; Onto: for any y ∈ R, x = a^y ∈ R⁺
(b)(ii) R is a function from {1,2} to B

questions.solution:
(a) One-one: Suppose f(x₁) = f(x₂), i.e., logₐ(x₁) = logₐ(x₂). Since the logarithmic function is strictly monotone, this implies x₁ = x₂. Thus f is injective. Onto: For any y ∈ R, let x = a^y. Then x ∈ R⁺ (since a > 0) and f(x) = logₐ(a^y) = y. So every y ∈ R has a pre-image in R⁺. Thus f is surjective. Hence f is a bijection.

(b) With A = {1,2,3} and B = {4,5,6}, and x+y = 6: for x=1, y=5 ∈ B ✔; for x=2, y=4 ∈ B ✔; for x=3, y=3 ∉ B ✖. So R = {(1,5),(2,4)}. R is a function from {1,2} to B since each element of the domain maps to exactly one element of B. Domain of R = {1,2}; Range of R = {4,5}.

questions.text:
(क) एक यादृच्छिक चर X का प्रायिकता बंटन नीचे दिया गया है :
X: 0, 1, 2, 3
P(X): p, p/3, p/6, p/12
(i) p का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
(ii) P(X ≥ 1) ज्ञात कीजिए।
(iii) E(X) ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) एक शहर में रहने वालों द्वारा यातायात के पसंदीदा साधन के बारे में सर्वे किया गया तथा यह पाया गया कि 50% लोग सार्वजनिक परिवहन के साधन पसंद करते हैं, 35% लोग साइकिल का प्रयोग पसंद करते हैं तथा 20% लोग सार्वजनिक परिवहन के साधन तथा साइकिल दोनों का प्रयोग करते हैं। प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि एक यादृच्छया चुना गया व्यक्ति :
(i) केवल सार्वजनिक परिवहन वाहन प्रयोग करता है।
(ii) साइकिल प्रयोग करता है जबकि दिया गया है कि वह सार्वजनिक परिवहन वाहन का भी प्रयोग करता है।
(iii) न तो सार्वजनिक परिवहन वाहन प्रयोग करता है और न ही साइकिल प्रयोग करता है।
questions.text_english:
(a) The probability distribution of a random variable X is given by:
X: 0, 1, 2, 3
P(X): p, p/3, p/6, p/12
(i) Determine the value of p.

OR

questions.text:
(क) यदि फलन f(x) = {(x² – 2x – 3)/(x+1), x ≠ −1; k, x = −1} x = – 1 पर संतत है, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) फलन f(x) = x|x| की x = 0 पर अवकलनीयता की जाँच कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find k so that f(x) = {(x² – 2x – 3)/(x+1), x ≠ −1; k, x = −1} is continuous at x = – 1.
OR
(b) Check the differentiability of function f(x) = x|x| at x = 0.

key_points: (b) f is differentiable at x = 0 with f'(0) = 0

questions.solution:
(a) For continuity at x = −1, k = lim(x→−1) (x² – 2x – 3)/(x+1). Factoring: x² – 2x – 3 = (x−3)(x+1). So lim = lim(x→−1) (x−3)(x+1)/(x+1) = lim(x→−1) (x−3) = −1 – 3 = −4. Therefore k = −4.

(b) f(x) = x|x| = x² for x ≥ 0 and –x² for x < 0. LHD at x=0: lim(h→0⁻) [f(0+h)–f(0)]/h = lim[f(h)]/h = lim[–h²]/h = lim(–h) = 0. RHD at x=0: lim(h→0⁺) [f(h)–f(0)]/h = lim[h²]/h = lim(h) = 0. Since LHD = RHD = 0, f is differentiable at x = 0 and f'(0) = 0.

questions.text: रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या के दिए गए ग्राफ से, सुसंगत क्षेत्र को संतुष्ट करने वाले सभी व्यवरोध लिखिए।
questions.text_english: For the given graph of a Linear Programming Problem, write all the constraints satisfying the given feasible region.
questions.solution: From the graph, the feasible region has corner points O(0,0), A(0,200), B(50,250), C(150,150), and D(200,0). The constraints defining this region are: x ≥ 0 (right of y-axis), y ≥ 0 (above x-axis), x + y ≤ 200 (the line through A(0,200) and D(200,0)), y ≤ 250 (horizontal line through B), and x + y ≤ 300 (line through B(50,250) and C(150,150) extended). The binding lines are: x + y = 200, x + y = 300, and y = 250 along with x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0.

questions.text:
सूर्य के प्रकाश के संपर्क में आने के सापेक्ष पौधे की ऊँचाई (y सेमी) के बीच का संबंध समीकरण y = 4x – (1/2)x² द्वारा नियंत्रित होता है, जहाँ x सूर्य के प्रकाश के संपर्क में आने वाले दिनों की संख्या है।
(i) सूर्य के प्रकाश के सापेक्ष पौधे की वृद्धि दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
(ii) कितने दिनों में पौधा अपनी अधिकतम ऊँचाई प्राप्त कर लेगा ? अधिकतम ऊँचाई कितनी है ?
questions.text_english:
The relation between the height of the plant (y cm) with respect to exposure to sunlight is governed by the equation y = 4x – (1/2)x², where x is the number of days exposed to sunlight.
(i) Find the rate of growth of the plant with respect to sunlight.
(ii) In how many days will the plant attain its maximum height? What is the maximum height?

sub_questions.text: सूर्य के प्रकाश के सापेक्ष पौधे की वृद्धि दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the rate of growth of the plant with respect to sunlight.
sub_questions.solution: The rate of growth is dy/dx. Differentiating y = 4x – (1/2)x² with respect to x: dy/dx = 4 – x. This gives the rate of growth of the plant per day of sunlight exposure.

sub_questions.text: कितने दिनों में पौधा अपनी अधिकतम ऊँचाई प्राप्त कर लेगा ? अधिकतम ऊँचाई कितनी है ?
sub_questions.text_english: In how many days will the plant attain its maximum height? What is the maximum height?
sub_questions.solution: For maximum height, set dy/dx = 0: 4 – x = 0, so x = 4 days. Since d²y/dx² = −1 < 0, this is indeed a maximum. Maximum height y = 4(4) – (1/2)(4)² = 16 – 8 = 8 cm. The plant attains its maximum height of 8 cm after 4 days of sunlight exposure.

key_points: Maximum at x = 4 days, maximum height = 8 cm

questions.solution: Given y = 4x – (1/2)x². (i) Rate of growth = dy/dx = 4 – x. (ii) Setting dy/dx = 0 gives x = 4. Since d²y/dx² = −1 < 0, x = 4 gives maximum. Maximum height = 4(4) – (1/2)(16) = 16 – 8 = 8 cm.

questions.text:
(क) दर्शाइए कि एक समांतर चतुर्भुज जिसके विकर्ण ⃗a तथा ⃗b द्वारा निरूपित हों, का क्षेत्रफल (1/2)|⃗a × ⃗b| द्वारा प्रदत्त होता है। अत: उस समांतर चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके विकर्ण 2î – ĵ + k̂ तथा î + 3ĵ – k̂ द्वारा प्रदत्त हैं।
अथवा
(ख) एक रेखा का सदिश तथा कार्तीय समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए जो बिंदु (1, 2, – 4) से होकर जाती है तथा दोनों रेखाओं (x−8)/3 = (y+19)/(−16) = (z−10)/7 तथा ⃗r = 15î + 29ĵ + 5k̂ + μ(3î + 8ĵ – 5k̂) के लंबवत है।
questions.text_english:
(a) Show that the area of a parallelogram whose diagonals are represented by ⃗a and ⃗b is given by (1/2)|⃗a × ⃗b|. Also find the area of a parallelogram whose diagonals are 2î – ĵ + k̂ and î + 3ĵ – k̂.
OR
(b) Find the equation of a line in vector and cartesian form which passes through the point (1, 2, – 4) and is perpendicular to the lines (x−8)/3 = (y+19)/(−16) = (z−10)/7 and ⃗r = 15î + 29ĵ + 5k̂ + μ(3î + 8ĵ – 5k̂).

key_points: (a) Area of parallelogram = (1/2)|a×b|; Area = √170/2 sq. units
(b) Direction vector = (2, 3, 6); Vector form r = (i+2j−4k) + λ(2i+3j+6k); Cartesian: (x−1)/2 = (y−2)/3 = (z+4)/6

questions.solution:
(a) If diagonals of a parallelogram are ⃗a and ⃗b, then the sides are (⃗a + ⃗b)/2 and (⃗a – ⃗b)/2. Area = |side₁ × side₂| = |(⃗a+⃗b)/2 × (⃗a–⃗b)/2| = (1/4)|⃗a×⃗a – ⃗a×⃗b + ⃗b×⃗a – ⃗b×⃗b| = (1/4)|0 – ⃗a×⃗b – ⃗a×⃗b – 0| = (1/2)|⃗a×⃗b|. For ⃗a = 2î–ĵ+k̂, ⃗b = î+3ĵ–k̂: ⃗a×⃗b = |i j k; 2 -1 1; 1 3 -1| = i(1−3) – j(−2−1) + k(6+1) = −2i+3j+7k. |⃗a×⃗b| = √(4+9+49) = √62. Area = (1/2)√62 sq. units.

(b) Direction vectors of given lines: d₁ = (3,−16,7), d₂ = (3,8,−5). Required direction d = d₁×d₂ = |i j k; 3 -16 7; 3 8 -5| = i(80−56)–j(−15−21)+k(24+48) = 24i+36j+72k = 12(2i+3j+6k). So direction is (2,3,6). Vector equation: ⃗r = (î+2ĵ−4k̂) + λ(2î+3ĵ+6k̂). Cartesian: (x−1)/2 = (y−2)/3 = (z+4)/6.

questions.text:
(क) मान ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫₀^(3/2) |x cos πx| dx
अथवा
(ख) ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫ dx/(sin x + sin 2x)
questions.text_english:
(a) Evaluate : ∫₀^(3/2) |x cos πx| dx
OR
(b) Find : ∫ dx/(sin x + sin 2x)
questions.solution:
(a) x cosπx = 0 when cosπx = 0 or x = 0; cosπx = 0 at x = 1/2, 3/2. For x ∈ [0, 1/2]: cosπx ≥ 0, so |x cosπx| = x cosπx. For x ∈ [1/2, 3/2]: cosπx ≤ 0, so |x cosπx| = –x cosπx. I = ∫₀^(1/2) x cosπx dx – ∫_(1/2)^(3/2) x cosπx dx. Using IBP: ∫ x cosπx dx = x sinπx/π + cosπx/π². Evaluating: I₁ = [x sinπx/π + cosπx/π²]₀^(1/2) = (1/2π·sin(π/2) + cos(π/2)/π²) – (0 + 1/π²) = 1/(2π) – 1/π². I₂ = [x sinπx/π + cosπx/π²]_(1/2)^(3/2) = (3/(2π)·sin(3π/2) + cos(3π/2)/π²) – (1/(2π) + 0/π²) = −3/(2π) – 1/(2π) = −2/π. I = I₁ – I₂ = (1/(2π) – 1/π²) – (−2/π) = 1/(2π) – 1/π² + 2/π = 5/(2π) – 1/π².

(b) sin x + sin 2x = sin x + 2 sin x cos x = sin x(1 + 2cos x). So ∫ dx/[sin x(1+2cos x)]. Multiply numerator and denominator by sin x: ∫ sin x dx/[sin²x(1+2cos x)] = ∫ sin x dx/[(1–cos²x)(1+2cos x)]. Let t = cos x, dt = –sin x dx: ∫ –dt/[(1–t²)(1+2t)] = ∫ dt/[(t²−1)(1+2t)]. Using partial fractions: 1/[(t−1)(t+1)(1+2t)] = A/(t−1) + B/(t+1) + C/(1+2t). Solving: A = 1/[2·3] = 1/6, B = 1/[(−2)(−1)] = 1/2... (full partial fraction decomposition). The result is: (1/6)ln|1–cos x| + (1/2)ln|1+cos x| – (1/3)ln|1+2cos x| + C.
questions.topic: Definite Integral with Absolute Value / Integration by Partial Fractions

questions.text: यदि A एक 3 × 3 व्युत्क्रमणीय आव्यूह है, तो दर्शाइए कि किसी अदिश k ≠ 0 के लिए (kA)⁻¹ = (1/k)A⁻¹. अत: (3A)⁻¹ परिकलित कीजिए, जहाँ A = [[2, −1, 1], [−1, 2, −1], [1, −1, 2]] है।
questions.text_english: If A is a 3 × 3 invertible matrix, show that for any scalar k ≠ 0, (kA)⁻¹ = (1/k)A⁻¹. Hence calculate (3A)⁻¹, where A = [[2, −1, 1], [−1, 2, −1], [1, −1, 2]].

questions.text:
कुछ छात्रों को दशमलवों की तुलना करते समय एक गलत धारणा होती है। उदाहरण के लिए, कोई छात्र 78.56 > 78.9 का उल्लेख कर सकता है क्योंकि 7856 > 789 है। इस अवधारणा का आकलन करने के लिए, अध्यापक द्वारा कक्षा VI के विद्यार्थियों को दशमलव तुलना परीक्षण के लिए निम्नलिखित प्रश्न दिया गया:
हाल ही में स्कूल में आयोजित खेल दिवस में, 5 छात्रों ने भाला फेंक प्रतियोगिता में भाग लिया। उन्होंने जितनी दूरी तक भाला फेंका है, वह नीचे की तालिका में दर्शाया गया है:

छात्र का नाम | भाले की दूरी (मीटर में)
अजय | 47.7
बिजॉय | 47.07
कार्तिक | 43.09
दिनेश | 43.9
देवेश | 45.2

विद्यार्थियों से पूछा गया कि वे बताएँ कि भाला सबसे दूर किसने फेंका है।
इस परीक्षा के आधार पर अध्यापक ने यह परिणाम प्राप्त किया कि 40% विद्यार्थियों को दशमलवों की तुलना में गलत धारणा है तथा शेष विद्यार्थियों को यह गलत धारणा नहीं है। परीक्षा में जिन विद्यार्थियों को यह गलत धारणा है, उनमें से 80% विद्यार्थियों ने बिजॉय को सही उत्तर के रूप में दिया जबकि जिन विद्यार्थियों को यह गलत धारणा नहीं है, उनमें से 90% ने अपना उत्तर बिजॉय नहीं दिया।
questions.text_english:
Some students are having a misconception while comparing decimals. For example, a student may mention that 78.56 > 78.9 as 7856 > 789. In order to assess this concept, a decimal comparison test was administered to the students of class VI through the following question:
In the recently held Sports Day in the school, 5 students participated in a javelin throw competition. The distances to which they have thrown the javelin are shown below in the table:

Name of student | Distance of javelin (in meters)
Ajay | 47.7
Bijoy | 47.07
Kartik | 43.09
Dinesh | 43.9
Devesh | 45.2

The students were asked to identify who has thrown the javelin the farthest.
Based on the test attempted by the students, the teacher concludes that 40% of the students have the misconception in the concept of decimal comparison and the rest do not have the misconception. 80% of the students having misconception answered Bijoy as the correct answer in the paper. 90% of the students who are identified with not having misconception, did not answer Bijoy as their answer.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त सूचना के आधार पर निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: On the basis of the above information, answer the following questions.

sub_questions.text: परीक्षा में एक विद्यार्थी जिसको यह गलत धारणा नहीं है, के बिजॉय, सही उत्तर के रूप में देने की प्रायिकता क्या है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the probability of a student not having misconception but still answers Bijoy in the test ?
sub_questions.solution: Students without misconception answer Bijoy with probability = 1 – 0.90 = 0.10. So P(Bijoy | no misconception) = 0.10.

sub_questions.text: इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि एक यादृच्छया चुना गया विद्यार्थी, परीक्षा में उत्तर के रूप में बिजॉय लिखता है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the probability that a randomly selected student answers Bijoy as his answer in the test ?

sub_questions.text: (क) एक विद्यार्थी जिसने बिजॉय उत्तर के रूप में दिया, की गलत धारणा होने की क्या प्रायिकता है ?
sub_questions.text_english: (a) What is the probability that a student who answered as Bijoy is having misconception ?

sub_questions.text: (ख) इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि एक विद्यार्थी जिसने अपना उत्तर बिजॉय दिया है, उन विद्यार्थियों में से है जिसे यह गलत धारणा नहीं है ?
sub_questions.text_english: (b) What is the probability that a student who answered as Bijoy is amongst students who do not have the misconception ?

questions.solution: Case study based question. Answers are provided in sub_questions.

questions.text: एक इंजीनियर एक शहर में नया मेट्रो रेल नेटवर्क डिज़ाइन कर रहा है। शुरू में, वह दो मेट्रो लाइनें A तथा B, विभिन्न स्टेशनों के लिए डिज़ाइन करता है। मेट्रो लाइन A का ट्रैक l₁ : (x−2)/3 = (y+1)/(−2) = (z−3)/4, जबकि लाइन B का ट्रैक l₂ : (x−1)/2 = (y−3)/1 = (z+2)/(−3) से निरूपित किया गया है।

The track for Line A is represented by l₁ : (x−2)/3 = (y+1)/(−2) = (z−3)/4, while the track for Line B is represented by l₂ : (x−1)/2 = (y−3)/1 = (z+2)/(−3).
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त सूचना पर आधारित, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions.

sub_questions.text: ज्ञात कीजिए कि क्या दो मेट्रो ट्रैक परस्पर समांतर हैं।
sub_questions.text_english: Find whether the two metro tracks are parallel.

key_points: Direction vectors (3,-2,4) and (2,1,-3) are not proportional, so lines are not parallel

sub_questions.solution: Direction vector of l₁ is d₁ = (3, −2, 4) and of l₂ is d₂ = (2, 1, −3). For parallel lines, d₁ = k·d₂ for some scalar k. Checking: 3/2 ≠ −2/1, so the direction vectors are not proportional. Therefore the two metro tracks are NOT parallel.

sub_questions.text: मेट्रो स्टेशनों की छतों पर सोलर पैनल लगाए जाने हैं। मेट्रो लाइन A के स्टेशनों की छतों पर, लाइन A के ट्रैक (l₁) के समांतर तथा बिंदु (1, – 2, – 3) से हो कर जाने वाले सौर पैनलों को निरूपित करने वाली रेखा का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Solar panels are to be installed on the rooftop of the metro stations. Determine the equation of the line representing the placement of solar panels on the rooftop of Line A's stations, given that panels are to be positioned parallel to Line A's track (l₁) and pass through the point (1, – 2, – 3).
sub_questions.solution: The required line is parallel to l₁ so it has the same direction vector (3, −2, 4) and passes through (1, −2, −3). The equation is (x−1)/3 = (y+2)/(−2) = (z+3)/4.

sub_questions.text: (क) स्टेशनों को जोड़ने के लिए, दोनों मेट्रो लाइनों के लंबवत एक पैदल यात्री पथ बनाना है जो बिंदु (3, 2, 1) से हो कर जाए। इस पैदल यात्री पथ का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) To connect the stations, a pedestrian pathway perpendicular to the two metro lines is to be constructed which passes through point (3, 2, 1). Determine the equation of the pedestrian walkway.
sub_questions.solution: The pedestrian pathway must be perpendicular to both l₁ and l₂, so its direction is d₁×d₂. d₁ = (3,−2,4), d₂ = (2,1,−3). d₁×d₂ = |i j k; 3 -2 4; 2 1 -3| = i(6−4)–j(−9−8)+k(3+4) = 2i+17j+7k. Passing through (3,2,1): (x−3)/2 = (y−2)/17 = (z−1)/7.

sub_questions.text: (ख) लाइन A तथा लाइन B के बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Find the shortest distance between Line A and Line B.

questions.text: भारी गेमिंग सत्र के दौरान, एक छात्र के लैपटॉप प्रोसेसर का तापमान काफी बढ़ जाता है। सत्र के बाद में यह ठंडा होने लगता है तथा इसके ठंडा होने की दर, प्रोसेसर के तापमान तथा कमरे के तापमान (25°C) के अंतर के समानुपाती है। आरंभ में प्रोसेसर का तापमान 85°C है तथा ठंडा होने की दर समीकरण d/dt(T(t)) = –k(T(t) – 25) द्वारा परिभाषित है, जहाँ T(t), समय t (मिनट में) पर प्रोसेसर के तापमान को निरूपित करता है तथा k एक अचर है।
questions.text_english: During a heavy gaming session, the temperature of a student's laptop processor increases significantly. After the session, the processor begins to cool down, and the rate of cooling is proportional to the difference between the processor's temperature and the room temperature (25°C). Initially the processor's temperature is 85°C. The rate of cooling is defined by the equation d/dt(T(t)) = –k(T(t) – 25), where T(t) represents the temperature of the processor at time t (in minutes) and k is a constant.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त सूचना पर आधारित, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions.

sub_questions.text: प्रोसेसर के तापमान T(t) के लिए व्यंजक ज्ञात कीजिए जबकि दिया गया है कि T(0) = 85°C है।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the expression for temperature of processor, T(t) given that T(0) = 85°C.
sub_questions.solution: The differential equation is dT/dt = –k(T – 25). Separating variables: dT/(T∥25) = –k dt. Integrating: ln|T∥25| = –kt + C, so T∥25 = Ae^(–kt). At t=0, T=85: 85∥25 = A, so A = 60. Therefore T(t) = 25 + 60e^(–kt).

sub_questions.text: प्रोसेसर के तापमान को 40°C तक आने में कितना समय लगेगा ? दिया गया है कि k = 0.03, logₑ 4 = 1.3863.
sub_questions.text_english: How long will it take for the processor's temperature to reach 40°C? Given that k = 0.03, logₑ 4 = 1.3863.
sub_questions.solution: Setting T(t) = 40: 40 = 25 + 60e^(–kt), so 15 = 60e^(–kt), giving e^(–kt) = 1/4. Taking natural log: –kt = –ln4, so t = ln4/k = 1.3863/0.03 ≈ 46.21 minutes. The processor takes approximately 46.21 minutes to cool down to 40°C.
